sihSubmissions.one_line_pitch: Low-bandwidth crowdsourced bus telemetry and route arrival estimator for rural commuters.
sihSubmissions.rejection_reason: Technical feasibility requires a clearer prototype methodology. Missing offline fallback architecture for remote regions with zero cellular connectivity. Please revise your technology stack and implementation plan.
sihSubmissions.review_feedback: Promising problem domain, but please address offline synchronization in your resubmission.
